name: moai-domain-design-dna
description: > Reverse-engineer a reference design — a screenshot, an image set, or a live URL — into a portable Design DNA JSON across three dimensions (measurable tokens, qualitative style, special-rendering effects), then generate a new self-contained artifact from that JSON. author: modu-ai
